description: End-to-end lifecycle management for SIM swap fraud detection, investigation, containment, and resolution in a telecom environment.

case_id.description: Unique identifier for a SIM swap fraud case

subscriber_id.description: Unique identifier for a telecom subscriber (e.g., CRM ID)

msisdn.description: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (phone number in E.164 format)

network_account_id.description: Internal network account identifier used for provisioning and SIM management

sim_id.description: Identifier of a physical SIM or eSIM profile

alert_id.description: Identifier of an automated fraud alert or rule trigger

agent_id.description: Identifier for a fraud operations or customer care agent

device_id.description: Unique device or IMEI identifier associated with the SIM or subscriber

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: ingest_sim_swap_alert
functions.description: Ingest a new SIM swap fraud alert from detection systems and create or link to an investigation case.

alert_source.description: System or channel where the alert originated

msisdn.description: Phone number associated with the suspected SIM swap

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber identifier if resolved at detection time

detection_scores.description: Risk scores from various detection models

individual_scores.description: Scores broken down by model or rule

reason_codes.description: Machine-readable reason codes contributing to this score

channel.description: Channel where the SIM change was initiated

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the triggering event

origin_ip.description: IP address associated with the request, if any

geo_location.description: Geo-location information related to the event

customer_report.description: Information provided directly by a customer, if applicable

correlation_hints.description: Optional hints for deduplicating or correlating alerts to existing cases

dedupe_key.description: Idempotency or deduplication key provided by caller

functions.returns: Created or updated fraud case reference including case_id, linkage to alert_id, initial status, and routing decision.

functions.name: get_sim_swap_case
functions.description: Retrieve full details of a SIM swap fraud case, including history, decisions, and linked alerts.

case_id.description: Identifier of the fraud case to retrieve

redaction_level.description: Controls level of data masking for sensitive attributes

functions.returns: SIM swap fraud case details including identification data, current status, risk scoring, actions taken, and optional related entities.

functions.name: list_sim_swap_cases
functions.description: List and filter SIM swap fraud cases for monitoring queues, analytics, or workload management.

tags.description: Case tags for routing or categorization

functions.returns: Paginated list of SIM swap fraud cases with summary information and metadata for navigation.

functions.name: enrich_sim_swap_context
functions.description: Pull network, device, and behavioral data to enrich a SIM swap case prior to or during investigation.

time_window.description: Time window for time-series data enrichment

relative_past_hours.description: Alternative to explicit from/to: look back N hours from now

network_account_id.description: Override network account ID if not resolvable from case; usually not required

options.description: Advanced options to control enrichment behavior

functions.returns: Updated case with attached enrichment datasets or references, and a summary of enrichment success/failure per scope.

functions.name: evaluate_sim_swap_risk
functions.description: Run or re-run SIM swap fraud risk assessment for a case, combining rules, models, and enrichment data.

evaluation_profile.description: Which configuration profile to use for scoring

override_features.description: Feature overrides for what-if or debugging scenarios

explainability_options.description: Controls generation of explanations and reason codes

functions.returns: Updated risk evaluation for the case including scores, reason codes, and recommended next actions (e.g., auto-contain, manual review, close).

functions.name: apply_sim_swap_containment
functions.description: Execute network and account-level containment actions to limit potential SIM swap fraud impact.

network_account_id.description: Target network account; if omitted, derived from the case

containment_plan.description: Declarative plan for desired containment state

sim_actions.description: Actions to apply to SIMs associated with the case

otp_and_auth_controls.description: Additional constraints for OTP and high-risk authentication flows

allowed_channels.description: Only allow these channels to perform key account changes

duration.description: How long the containment should remain in effect

ttl_minutes.description: Time-to-live in minutes when mode is fixed_duration

execution_mode.description: Control whether actions are simulated or actually executed

requested_by.description: Identity of the agent or system that requested the containment

functions.returns: Result of applying containment actions, including per-action status, any failures, and references to network change orders.

functions.name: start_customer_verification_flow
functions.description: Initiate an out-of-band customer verification flow to confirm or refute suspected SIM swap fraud.

verification_channel.description: Primary channel for contacting the customer

verification_scenario.description: Scenario template determining questions and flows

customer_contacts.description: Contact details to be used for this verification attempt

security_questions.description: Optional set of security questions to be used in the flow

callback_metadata.description: Webhook or callback configuration for async verification results

functions.returns: Verification session details including verification_id, channel status, expiry, and next steps for collecting or evaluating responses.

functions.name: record_sim_swap_investigation_action
functions.description: Record manual investigation notes, decisions, and state transitions for a SIM swap fraud case.

attachments.description: References to documents or artifacts reviewed or added

customer_contact_outcome.description: Outcome when the action involves customer contact

update_case_status.description: If true, case status will be updated using new_status in action_details

functions.returns: Updated case audit trail entry with timestamps and any resulting status changes.

functions.name: resolve_sim_swap_case
functions.description: Finalize a SIM swap fraud case as confirmed fraud, false positive, or other terminal outcome and trigger downstream processes.

fraud_impact.description: Details of financial or service impact where fraud is confirmed or suspected

remediation_actions.description: Customer restitution or corrections to apply

notify_external_parties.description: Configure regulatory or partner notifications for confirmed or significant fraud

auto_release_containment.description: If true, triggers automatic rollback of containment where safe

functions.returns: Finalized case record with terminal status, recorded impact and remediation, and any initiated notifications or downstream actions.

functions.name: rollback_sim_swap_containment
functions.description: Safely reverse previously applied containment actions once a case is resolved or deemed false positive.

case_id.description: Case whose containment is being rolled back

custom_rollback_plan.description: Fine-grained rollback plan when rollback_scope is custom

safety_checks.description: Additional conditions that must be met before rollback is committed

functions.returns: Summary of rollback operations performed or simulated, including any actions skipped due to safety checks.

functions.name: retry_network_actions_for_case
functions.description: Retry failed or partially applied network operations related to a SIM swap fraud case, such as suspensions or restorations.

case_id.description: Case whose network actions should be retried

retry_filters.description: Criteria for selecting which past network actions to retry

batch_options.description: Control batching and concurrency behavior for retries

functions.returns: Batch retry result including per-action retry outcome, updated statuses, and any residual failures requiring manual intervention.

functions.name: get_sim_swap_case_status_timeline
functions.description: Retrieve the status history and key lifecycle milestones for a SIM swap fraud case.

case_id.description: Case whose status history is requested

include_network_events.description: Whether to merge in related network event statuses (suspensions, restores)

time_zone.description: Preferred time zone for human-readable timestamps (e.g., 'UTC', 'Europe/London')

functions.returns: Ordered timeline of status transitions, key events, and associated metadata for the case, suitable for audit or SLA analysis.

functions.name: escalate_sim_swap_case
functions.description: Escalate a SIM swap fraud case to higher operational tiers, specialized teams, or external parties.

detailed_description.description: Narrative summary with key facts, requested actions, and deadlines

attachments.description: Supporting documents or evidence to attach to escalation

sla.description: Desired service level agreement for the escalation

functions.returns: Escalation record with tracking identifier, routing details, and updated case escalation state.

functions.name: sim_swap_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import sim swap entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: sim_swap_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many sim swap entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: sim_swap_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many sim swap entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: sim_swap_bulk_export
functions.description: Export sim swap entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: sim_swap_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across sim swap entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: sim_swap_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for sim swap events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: sim_swap_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for sim swap notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: sim_swap_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more sim swap entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: sim_swap_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to sim swap on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: sim_swap_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a sim swap operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: sim_swap_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending sim swap change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: sim_swap_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending sim swap approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: sim_swap_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a sim swap entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: sim_swap_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a sim swap entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: sim_swap_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a sim swap entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: sim_swap_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a sim swap entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: sim_swap_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for sim swap activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: sim_swap_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a sim swap view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: sim_swap_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to sim swap entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: sim_swap_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given sim swap payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: sim_swap_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a sim swap entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: sim_swap_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a sim swap entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
